$ podkop device 2001:db8:5::5
# an IPv6 address, and a rule of every device (Main)
exit 0
--- stdout
ℹ️ The rules for 2001:db8:5::5, in the order they are matched:
✅ Rule Main (main) takes its connections to the lists of the rule, as those of every device: through its servers
➡️ What no rule takes goes directly
